description: Account class with all members defined out of class, including a static member and printing destructor.
tricky_aspect: Declaration omits parameter names and holds the default argument; deposit's parameter shadows the field and uses this->value, while withdraw calls balance() without this->.
expected:
open alice 100
open anon 5
b=15 count=2
anon insufficient
close anon 15
a=77 count=1
close alice 77

description: Dynamic Matrix with copy constructor, assignment operator, operator* and const/non-const at() overloads used for recursive fast exponentiation.
tricky_aspect: at() overloads differ only by const and return int& vs const int&, the constructor parameters shadow fields in the init list, and self-assignment is guarded.

description: Course and Student refer to each other through pointers, with Course declared first and Student's members defined before Course's.
tricky_aspect: Forward declaration plus definitions in a different order than declarations, a Student** array, and passing this into another class's method.

Ann joined Math
Bob joined Math
Cid rejected by Math
Ann rejected by Math
Cid joined Art
Ann joined Art
Math: Ann(2) Bob(1)

~Course Art with 2
~Course Math with 2

description: Binary search tree node whose insert, sum, height and recursive destructor are all defined outside the class.
tricky_aspect: height() is defined before the constructor, insert uses a reference-to-pointer slot, and static counters are verified after recursive deletion.

inserted 80
inserted 65

description: Dynamic stack with a private grow helper, chained operator<< and an RPN evaluator using it.
tricky_aspect: top() is overloaded only by const (int& vs int), operator<< is defined before push which it calls, and C++17 left-to-right << sequencing determines output order.
expected:
rpn=(grow to 4)
~Stack size=1
3
top=43 size=3
43 2 1 
~Stack size=0

Car Alpha
Car Beta
Beta has no engine
a=150 b=60
b engine hp=80

end of scope

description: Fraction class with out-of-class operators, a static recursive gcd, overloaded print and recursion for harmonic numbers.
tricky_aspect: Default arguments with unnamed parameters enable implicit int conversion, operator+= reuses operator+ through *this, and a pointer walks an array of objects.

inner: start
